dslRule:
<!id: boolean.getproperty.migrate.auto-build-property>
<!description: Update VM property name from JDT-specific 'org.eclipse.jdt.core.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange' to a more generic 'org.eclipse.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange'. This property controls auto-building on JDT core settings changes.>
<!severity: WARNING>

java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.eclipse.jdt.core.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange")
=>
java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.eclipse.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange")
;;
summary: Replaces the JDT-specific VM property name 'org.eclipse.jdt.core.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange' with 'org.eclipse.disableAutoBuildOnSettingsChange' in Boolean.getBoolean() calls.
